name: White Plume Guards
headerMeta: Golden era · Melee infantry · Tower Shield · 305 leadership · Chaos Season
pitch: A tower-shield frontline anchor that soaks damage for the team, holding the wall so your own cavalry and DPS can work behind it. It folds against high-minimum-damage units that punch straight through block — Liao Rangers, Iron Reapers, and Rattan Roundshields all beat it, and anything that can simply get through you (Queen's Knights, Reapers) causes it real trouble.

battleRole.positioning: Front-line for your team, protecting your DPS — you're fixing the front lane. Don't bait your own DPS units into the fight and don't let this unit get flanked. {1}
battleRole.tips: CCi doctrine is key for tanking trebuchets while fighting on a wall, and equally key for eating cavalry charges (or just to fall back safely). {1}
